# FurTrouble

> Real-world pet problem writeups: the symptom, what we tried that failed, and what actually worked in the end. Cats, dogs and exotic pets.

FurTrouble is a US-focused pet-care blog. Articles are first-person problem accounts based on lived experience and community reports, not generic listicles. Some outbound product links are Amazon Associates affiliate links.

Site: https://furtrouble.com
Updated: 2026-10-27
